h: Adekunle Gold announces $20,000 initiative for sickle cell patients in four countries
p: Singer Adekunle Gold has launched a $20,000 programme to support people living with sickle cell across four countries. The announcement drew praise from fans online.
more: The programme covers patients in four countries.
Fans have praised the gesture on social media.
